description: Test file for the AlwaysPullImages admission controller in Kubernetes, verifying image pull policies for pods during admission and updates.

methods.name: TestAdmission
methods.description: Tests that all containers and volumes in a pod have their image pull policy set to Always during admission.

methods.name: TestValidate
methods.description: Validates that invalid image pull policies are rejected with appropriate errors.

methods.name: TestOtherResources
methods.description: Ensures the admission controller is a no-op for non-pod resources and subresources.

methods.name: TestUpdatePod
methods.description: Ensures the admission controller is a no-op for updates when images are unchanged.
